Professor Boyd-Graber is a Professor of Natural Language Processing and Human–AI Collaboration in the College of Computing & Data Science. 

Professor Boyd-Graber is a Professor of Natural Language Processing and Human-AI Collaboration in the College of Computing & Data Science at Nanyang Technological University.
